bgm.name: ORAS Dungeon - Petalburg Woods (Petalburg Woods) (Petalburg Woods)

parameters: \bHey, you.\nIt gets awfully dark ahead.\nIt'll be tough trying to explore.
\bThat guy who came by earlier…\nSteven, I think it was.
\bHe knew how to use Flash, so he ought\nto be all right, but…
\bWell, for us Hikers, helping out those\nthat we meet is our motto.
\bHere you go, I'll pass this on to you.
\bTeach that hidden move Flash to\na POKéMON and use it.
\bIt lights up even the inky darkness\nof caves.
\bBut, to use it, you need the Gym Badge\nfrom Dewford's POKéMON Gym.
